name: Order Number
description: Customer Order Number, Purchase Order Number

name: Order Status
description: Status for the lifecycle of the customer order between the customer and Maersk - not directly between the customer and supplier. Examples: pending, accepted, cancelled

name: Order Booking Status
description: Indicator for whether the customer order has been booked on a shipper booking line(s), value from Customer Order level

name: Order Document Type
description: An order document type as used in customer ERP/SAP solutions, sample values, ZCH, ZFL, ZIB, ZIR, ZIS, ZWE

description: Types of customer orders, e.g. Purchase Order, Sales Order, Fulfillment Order, Manufacturing Order, Production Order, Demand Order, etc.

name: Factory Order Number
description: Order Number issued by Factory

name: Partial Update Allowed
description: Indicates whether it is allowed to partially update the order, i.e. only update a subset of customer products on the order.

name: Update All Lines?
description: Indicates if all Customer order lines must be updated when there is Customer Order revision

name: Ordered Package Unit
description: Unit of measurement for Order Package

name: Ordered Package Quantity
description: Total number of packages ordered by customer, value from Customer Order level

description: Ordered Item Quantity

name: Subdivision Code
description: Customer organizational subdivision, this field is to store the code

name: Subdivision Name
description: Customer organizational subdivision, this field is to store the name

name: Plant Code
description: A location code given to a plant where goods are produced or to be shipped to

name: Plant Name
description: A location name given to a plant where goods are produced or to be shipped to

name: Store Number
description: Customer store at destination, value can be a store number, store ID

name: Department Code
description: Department code used by the customer sending the order.

name: Department Name
description: Department name used by the customer sending the order.

name: Section Code
description: Section code used by the customer sending the order

name: Section Name
description: Section name used by the customer sending the order

name: Subsection Code
description: Subsection code used by the customer sending the order

name: Subsection Name
description: Subsection name used by the customer sending the order

name: Master Contact Number
description: Agreement between seller and buyer

name: Order Created Date (UTC)
description: Date when Customer Order is created/generated in Maersk platform

name: Order Upload Date (UTC)
description: Date when Customer Order is created/generated in Maersk platform

name: Order Confirmed Date (UTC)
description: The date and time that the order was confirmed by the party producing or supplying the goods in the order

name: Order Effective From (UTC)
description: The date and time where the order becomes effective

name: Order Effective To (UTC)
description: The date and time where the order becomes ineffective

name: Order Line Key
description: Order Line Key

description: Customer reference to identify a unique customer order line

name: Maersk Responsible E-mail
description: Internal Maersk entity being responsible for the client/customer/consignee

name: Ordered Weight (Gross)
description: Total gross weight of the packed products on the customer order

name: Ordered Weight (Net)
description: Total net weight of the packed products on the customer order line

name: Ordered Volume
description: Ordered volume of the Customer Order

name: Ordered Quantity Unit
description: Unit of measurement for Order Quantity

name: Ordered Quantity
description: Order Line Ordered Quantity

name: Ordered Item Quantity Unit
description: Order Line Ordered Item Quantity Unit

name: Total Selling Price Currency
description: ISO 3 letter currency code, e.g. USD, EUR, etc.

name: Total Selling Price
description: Total selling price of the all products ordered in this customer order line

name: Total Purchase Price Currency
description: ISO 3 letter currency code, e.g. USD, EUR, etc.

name: Total Purchase Price
description: Total purchase price of the all products ordered in this customer order line

name: Total Transfer Price Currency
description: ISO 3 letter currency code, e.g. USD, EUR, etc.

name: Total Transfer Price
description: Total transfer price of the all products ordered in this customer order line. Transfer pricing is the setting of the price for goods and services sold between controlled or related legal entities within an enterprise.

name: Partial Delivery Allowed?
description: Indicate whether the Customer Order line is allowed to be split in to partial deliveries. Example: customer orders 200 pairs of shoes and allows 100 pairs to be shipped first and the rest can be shipped later

name: Hazardous?
description: Indicates whether the customer order line represents and hazardous cargo

name: Priority?
description: Indicate whether the cargo is to be prioritized

name: Customer Order Line?
description: Indicates whether this order line was provided by the customer (true), if not it is assumed that order data was provided by shipper (false)

name: Marks & Numbers
description: Shipping mark on customer order line

name: Description
description: Order Line Description

name: Certificate Issued?
description: Indicates whether necessary certificate for the goods have been issued

name: Booked Status
description: Indicator for whether the customer order line has been booked on a shipper booking line(s), value from customer order line level

name: Incoterm
description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms) are internationally recognized standard trade terms used in sales contracts. Example: CIF, FOB, FCA, DDP, etc.

name: Payment Start Date (UTC)
description: The date and time that payment for the goods must be started

name: Payment Notes
description: Any note pertaining to the payment of the goods

name: Payment Term
description: Payment terms that are agreed between a seller and a buyer. Examples: Cash on Delivery (COD), Cash in Advance (CIA), Payment in Advance (PIA), Forward Collection, Bill of Exchange - A promise to pay at a later date, usually supported by a bank

name: Payment Mode
description: Agreed mode of payment between buyer and seller.  Examples:Wire Transfer (TT), Cheque, Cash, Debit Card, Credit Card

name: Cargo Type
description: The cargo characteristic that is relevant to transport order execution, e.g. Dry, Flatpack, Garment on Hanger, Dangerous Goods

name: Customer Product Number
description: Represent the customers unique identifier for the product. It can be an SKU (Stock Keeping Unit), Material Code or Product ID that the customer associates with the product which their supplier has agreed to source or manufacture.

name: Vendor Product Number
description: Vendors unique identifier for the product.

name: Product Description
description: Description of goods is to store a combined text of cargo description, including commodity name, order number, product components (e.g. 100% cotton) etc., value from customer product level

name: Product Category
description: Category of the Product

name: Product Line
description: Group of related products all marketed under a single brand name that is sold by the same company

name: Product Type
description: Group of products which fulfill a similar need for a market segment or market as a whole

name: Product Item Pack Quantity
description: Number of product items put together e.g. in a plastic wrapping to be sold to end consumer

name: Consignee SKU Number
description: SKU number on the Customer Order line

name: Batch Number
description: A specific quantity of a drug, cosmetics, food or other material that is intended to have uniform character and quality, within specified limits, and is produced according to a single manufacturing order during the same cycle of manufacture

name: Shelf Life
description: The maximum time a commodity can be stored. This can be kept in ISO 8601 ABNF format so that no transit time unit is needed. For example PT1H expresses a duration of 1 hour.

name: Shelf Life Unit
description: Unit of measurement for Shelf Life

name: Product Height
description: Dimension of the product

name: Product Length
description: Dimension of the product

name: Product Length Unit
description: Unit of measurement for Product Length

name: Product Width
description: Dimension of the product

name: Product Volume
description: Ordered volume of the product itself

name: Product Volume Unit
description: Unit of measurement for product volume

name: Product Net Weight
description: Net Weight of the product itself

name: Product Net Net Weight
description: Net  Weight of the product itself

name: Product Weight Unit
description: Unit of measurement for product gross weight

name: Unit Purchase Price Currency
description: ISO 3 letter currency code, e.g. USD, EUR, etc.

name: Unit Purchase Price
description: The purchase price for a single product item

name: Unit Selling Price Currency
description: ISO 3 letter currency code, e.g. USD, EUR, etc.

name: Unit Selling Price

name: Unit Transfer Price Currency

name: Unit Transfer Price
description: The transfer price for a single product item. Transfer pricing is the setting of the price for goods and services sold between controlled or related legal entities within an enterprise.

name: Lot Number
description: A lot number is an identification number assigned to a particular quantity or lot of material from a single manufacturer. Lot numbers can typically be found on the outside of packaging.

name: Default Lot Number
description: A lot number is an identification number assigned to a particular quantity or lot of material from a single manufacturer. Lot numbers can typically be found on the outside of packaging.

name: Country Of Origin
description: Country or region where product originally comes from

name: HTS
description: A unique code within a Commodity Coding System (such as the Harmonized Tarriff Schedule) for classification of goods or products used when importing goods.

name: UPC number
description: Universal Product Code which identifies a product contained in the Cargo Package. It could be a Universal Product Code (UPC) , European article numbering (EAN) or Global Trade Item Number (GTIN)

name: Cargo Package Type
description: Package unit, e.g. CARTON or PALLET, values from Cargo package specifications on Customer Order Line

name: Pack length
description: Dimension of the package

name: Pack Width
description: Dimension of the package

name: Pack Height
description: Dimension of the package

name: Buyer

name: Consolidator
description: A consolidator is a company specializing in combining cargo shipments from multiple shippers into full container loads

name: Supplier
description: The first stage of supply chain and responsible for purchasing and procurement operations in supply chain. Raw materials are purchased by supplier for which a companys needs to procure goods/services that are required to manufacture a product

name: Seller
description: Sellers are producers or owners of some product or skill that is available for sale to a purchaser

name: Transferred?
description: Flag indicates if this PO-SKU has been transferred

name: Transferee shipper
description: The party which the PO-SKU was transferred to. Only applicable for transferred POs

name: PO First Acceptance Date (UTC)
description: This date represents the first acceptance date when the Purchase order was accepted by the shipper.

name: PO Latest Acceptance Date (UTC)
description: In case a Purchase order was accepted by the shipper multiple times, this date represents the latest acceptance date when the Purchase order was accepted by the shipper.

name: PO First Rejection Date (UTC)
description: This date represents the first date when the shipper rejected the Purchase order.

name: PO Latest Rejection Date (UTC)
description: In case a Purchase order was rejected by a shipper multiple times, then this date represents the latest date when the Purchase order was rejected by a shipper

name: Order Priority
description: Used to identify the Orders lines (SKU level) which the customer needs to consolidate into 1 shipment. This attribute is used to identify the Order lines which are part of the same shipment.

name: Consolidation Id
description: Used to identify the Orders which the customer needs to consolidate into 1 shipment

name: Remark External
description: External Remark per Customer Order line
